structure.description: 未画区域是主动塑造的形体，少量实景以边缘、方向与墨色激活空白。

subject_rules.primary: keep physical motifs compact and let the void carry the main atmosphere

zones: the majority of the picture plane

visual_flow.primary: from inked motif into active blank space

generation.style: treat void as a compositional mass, not as unfinished background
